geography_conflicts.rule: Entry and associated dungeon world must have the same official root world. Conflicts remain in raw map_points, not in displayed locations.

client_export.name_source: Official content.{translation_type}.{id} entries in downloaded texts_fr.properties
client_export.schema_source: Fields and types read from the downloaded current wakfu-client.jar; every record boundary validated
limits: Creature definitions include NPCs, summons, quest variants, test content and obsolete records; not a list of all currently fightable enemies
Dungeon monster membership is explicit; parent world is an associated world, not always the entry coordinate
Ecosystem references describe family population requirements, not exact per-species spawn points
Map descriptions may contain unevaluated access criteria; no guarantee of access
Anonymous fields, raw drop condition vectors, and world loot definitions are preserved without inferred semantics
